task_description: Replace IntaSend + Daraja STK Push with a manual I&M Bank Paybill payment flow. Student enters M-Pesa transaction code after paying to Paybill 542542 / Account 313126. Booking is saved as pending_verification. Admin verifies or rejects in a new admin UI. On verification: BookingService::confirmBooking() runs, session codes sent to student and tutor. On rejection: PaymentRejected notification sent, booking cancelled.
